C'est le Xel. Avant de kicker, on remet:
It's Xel. Before you spit, let's get real: the gear.
Your phone's mic is enough for demos. For top sound:
• Wired headphones on your ears: you hear the beat and it doesn't leak into the mic. Avoid Bluetooth while you record your vocals.
• A small mic that plugs into the phone is the real jump in quality.
• A quiet room full of fabric (curtains, bed, clothes), not a bathroom.
• Your mouth 15–20 cm (6–8 in) from the mic, and the phone in airplane mode so a notification doesn't ruin the take.

And let's be honest: StudioXel is your sketchbook. You lay down ideas, test flows, make demos. The final sound is made with a sound engineer, in a real equipped studio. Show up with your demo: you save time, they save time, and your song just wins.
Toi c'est déjà fait ✅ Montre-le à tes po: You've already done it ✅ Show it to your MC friends.

Deux façons de démarrer :\n🎤 Je te guide:
Two ways to start:
🎤 I guide you through your first song, step by step: you tap what I show you, I handle the rest. Recommended if it's your first time.
📖 Or I give you a tour of all the buttons.
You'll find both in Settings anytime.
Touche « Importer » sur la piste Instru: Tap “Import” on the Beat track and choose your beat (MP3 or WAV). I find the BPM and the key by myself, and I set the level. It's the very first thing to do.
R arme la piste : c'est là que ta voix v: R arms the track: that's where your voice will be recorded. M mutes the track, S plays it alone. By default you have Beat, Verses for your verses, Hook (already slightly doubled to sound wider), Back and Ad-libs. Arm Verses before your first verse.
Piste armée ? Touche REC : 4 bips de déc: Track armed? Tap REC: 4 countdown beeps and you spit. The MIC bar at the top moves with your voice, your take is drawn on the track live, and your lyrics show at the bottom if written (Lyrics tab). Tap REC again to stop. If the track already has a take, the new one goes on top at that spot (Undo to go back), and you hear 1 bar of your previous take to pick up the flow right on time (pre-roll, adjustable). To keep both, add a track with + or duplicate with ⧉: your call.
Allume-le pour t'entendre en direct avec: Turn it on to hear yourself live with the armed track's effects, auto-tune included, even without recording: perfect to warm up. Headphones are ideal, and I turn it on by myself as soon as I detect them. On the phone speaker it won't turn on: the mic is right next to the speaker, it would squeal for sure. On Bluetooth (car, speaker), if it squeals, I remove the squeal by myself.
Ici je t'affiche ce que j'ai détecté : 🎧: Here I show what I detected: 🎧 your headphones (AirPods…), 🚗 a car or speaker Bluetooth, or 📱 the speaker. If I'm wrong, tap it and choose yourself.
▶ lance ou met en pause, ⏹ arrête, ⏮ rev: ▶ plays or pauses, ⏹ stops, ⏮ goes back to the start. 🔁 loops the sung part you're on, perfect for tweaking your effects. The bar below shows where you are in the song: tap it or slide on it to move, the small lines are your markers. Listen back to your take right after laying it down, that's when you know if it's good.
Une bêtise ? Annuler revient en arrière,: Messed up? Undo goes back step by step: a take, an effect, a deleted track, everything can be undone.
VOL règle le niveau de la piste, PAN la: VOL sets the track level, PAN places it left or right. I already set the levels by myself, you fine-tune if needed. Tip: lead in the center, backs slightly to the sides.
« ✨ Style » règle tout d'un coup : Propr:
“✨ Style” sets everything at once: Clean, Dark & gritty, Airy, Drowned, Banging hook, Raw or Lo-fi. Or tap an effect to turn it on, tap again to set the amount. Reverb for space, Echo for line endings, Double to thicken a hook, Auto-tune to correct or stylize (Natural, Heavy, Robot, or Floating mode 🛸 with the whole vibe), Warmth for grain, Radio for a voice filtered like a telephone or lo-fi.
The amounts really change the sound: Reverb goes from a room to a big hall, Echo from a short slap to a big end-of-line echo. You can even adjust it mid-take.
🔓 verrouille une prise réussie : plus ri: 🔓 locks a good take: nothing can damage it by mistake. ↑ and ↓ (right of the volume) move the track up or down: order them however you want. ⧉ duplicates the track. ✕ deletes it.
Touche la pastille pour changer la coule: Tap the dot to change the track color. Handy to find your way when you stack backs.
Glisse le doigt pour avancer dans le mor:
Slide your finger to move through the song. A tap places the playhead. A long press on a line selects it: you can delete it, move it or send it to another track.
For precise work: double-tap a take, or its magnifier 🔍. It opens big: you select with your finger, loop it, and cut, raise the volume, fade, repeat a part, cut all the gaps at once (perfect for backs) or shift the take by 10 ms steps. The top bar (play, pause, REC) stays there.
Les loupes zooment et dézooment la timel: The magnifiers zoom the timeline in and out. Zoom in to cut a line precisely.
Ajoute une piste, pose un repère (couple: Add a track, place a marker (verse, hook), start a loop to redo just one line, and find all your sessions. Everything saves itself.
Le bandeau tout en haut : « Mode simple: The banner at the very top: “Simple mode” hides the tools to keep it essential, step by step. “Advanced mode” is everything you see here. One tap, it switches instantly.
Ils s'ouvrent en plein écran ; « ✕ Ferme: They open full screen; “✕ Close” (at the top or at the very bottom) takes you back where you were. The Simple / Advanced choice is also at the very top of the main screen. Enter your artist name: it signs your tracks. Everything is sorted by section: recording (tempo, countdown, metronome), listening (Auto, Headphones or Speaker) if the listening badge is wrong. In “Automatic or manual”, you choose what I do by myself: monitoring, lyrics during the take, lyric sync, level setting. And if you want to redo your first song step by step: “🎤 Guided first song”.
Ici tu peaufines ta voix. En haut, la zo: Here you polish your voice. At the top, the zone to listen to: tap one or more sung parts (or drag the handles) and loop them while you tweak. “🎯 Follows the vocals” shows the singing track by itself. Then: voice styles in one tap, effects in full, EQ and compression to go deep. “Rebalance” puts the levels back in place.
La touche finale de ta maquette : un sty: The final touch on your demo: a style and a volume (Streaming or Loud). Your song comes out clean and loud, without ever clipping.
Écris tes lyrics ici, ou touche « 🎙️ Dic: Write your lyrics here, or tap “🎙️ Dictate my lyrics” and say them: they write themselves (proofread, dictation gets rap wrong). The prompter scrolls them while you spit. I sync the lyrics by myself: to the tempo during your first take, then right on your voice once the take is down. You can always sync by hand. The sync also comes out as subtitles in your Reels.

Reverb (Pièce, Studio, Salle), Écho (Sla: Reverb (Room, Studio, Hall), Echo (Slap, Ping-pong, Big), Double, Auto-tune (Natural, Heavy, Robot, Floating 🛸), Warmth and Radio. Tap to turn on, tap again to choose the amount or turn off. You hear it live.

En haut, « Ton instru » : toute ton inst: At the top, “Your beat”: your whole beat in big, with the parts I hear (intro, probable verses and hooks), my start suggestions (▲) and the start of your lyrics (in green). Tap the waveform to position yourself, ▶ to check, “📍 Lyrics start here” to choose, “👆 Sync my parts while listening”: the beat starts and a big button shows your next section ([Couplet 1], [Refrain]…). You tap when it starts, I snap it to the start of the nearest bar, and your lyric times update right away. This sync is then used for all your tracks, and if you record everything in one go, I put the hooks on the Hook track and the verses on Verses. A silence between two parts? Tap “🔇 Gap” when the part stops. As many verses and hooks as you want: after your lyrics' sections run out, it keeps going by itself (and “is it a hook?” flips it if I'm wrong). “↶ Oops” erases the last tap. At the end, your sections [Couplet 1], [Refrain]… start right on each part. When you load your beat, I also suggest where to start the lyrics: where the drums come in (⭐ my pick), a few bars later, a change in the beat, or from the very start. Tap a suggestion to hear it and pick it. You can also set it by hand (📍 Here, or ± 1 bar). Place markers named after your sections (+ → Marker): each section starts right on it. The lyrics scroll one line per bar: each line lands right on beat 1 of a bar, thanks to your beat's BPM (one line per half bar if a part is too full). And it stays the same on all your tracks. To force it, open “Lyrics speed”. Then the lyrics scroll one line per bar, the same on all your tracks. You can also sync by hand (“Sync next line” at the start of each line during playback), or force “Sync to my take” / “Sync to tempo”. During REC, your lyrics show at the bottom by themselves.
